title: Quenched Creamy Brazilian Chicken Pasta
description: A creamy and umami Brazilian dish featuring lacquer-glazed chicken, whole wheat pasta, and low-calorie ingredients, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe combines the flavors of Brazil with a healthy twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the whole wheat pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, Greek yogurt, lacquer glaze, and garlic powder.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a large skillet, cook the chicken breast pieces over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Add the cooked chicken to the pasta mixture and toss to combine.
Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
